pr.description: Fast deterministic seeded corpus for PR and release-regression checks.

scenarios.label: Raw warning becomes a block when graph context shows broad production impact.
scenarios.rationale: A raw medium warning in a shared production entrypoint affects many callees, so graph context changes the merge decision.

scenarios.label: Raw warning stays non-blocking when project shape shows test-only scope.
scenarios.rationale: Architecture context explains scope but does not change the review decision.

scenarios.label: Missing graph context is inconclusive.
scenarios.rationale: Without graph/project-shape evidence, the scenario should not count as decision-changing.

scenarios.label: A raw warning becomes non-blocking when project shape identifies generated adapter code.
scenarios.rationale: Project-shape context changes the merge decision by distinguishing generated adapter glue from hand-authored production logic.
